name: M15 synchronized USD breadth-transition basket follow and fade screening batch

research.category: intraday cross-symbol USD breadth transition screening

source_references.citation: Menkhoff, Sarno, Schmeling and Schrimpf (2012), Currency Momentum Strategies, Journal of Financial Economics 106(3), 660-684
source_references.supports: The opened paper studies monthly winner-minus-loser portfolios across up to 48 currencies from 1976-2010 and reports substantial cost sensitivity. It does not test a six-pair common-USD M15 breadth transition, a simultaneous USD basket, or 30-60-minute response.

research.evidence_summary: The primary paper establishes that cross-currency information can define a portfolio but its estimand and horizon do not transfer. This five-of-six synchronized USD-breadth rule is an original speculative test of both response signs.

feasibility.rationale: Uses only synchronized completed M15 OHLC for six already declared pairs, per-leg prior ATR, signal-close fills and same-day exits. It requires atomic six-symbol feature and basket semantics that V2 has not confirmed.

market.base_timeframe: Synchronized M1 aggregated causally to M15
market.session: Weekday basket signals from synchronized completed M15 bars ending 09:00 through 13:45 Europe/London; every leg exits no later than 15:00

data.frequency: Interval-start M1 OHLC synchronized across all six pairs and aggregated into Europe/London wall-clock M15 intervals
data.minimum_history: Fixed V2 development data only, with 98 valid observed M15 closes per symbol through t and all six t-5..t windows synchronized and physically contiguous
preprocessing: Treat M1 timestamp ts as [ts,ts+1 minute) and require 15 consecutive unique valid candles per symbol per London M15 bar
Valid OHLC is finite and positive with high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), high>=low; any symbol defect suppresses the synchronized pre-entry event
Require identical UTC interval ends for all six M15 bars at each index t-5..t
Use orientation q=-1 for EURUSD GBPUSD AUDUSD NZDUSD and q=+1 for USDCHF USDCAD so positive q*log return means USD strength
Compute each symbol's observed-sequence TR and Wilder ATR(96), seeded by the first 96 valid TRs and frozen through t-1
Use IANA Europe/London rules and canonical UTC storage
dependencies: Atomic six-leg basket entry and cell accounting
V2 resolved signal-time spread, commission and slippage for every leg
limitations: The inspected monthly cross-sectional paper does not support this intraday common-factor rule
Only six highly USD-dependent pairs are observed
Five-of-six and four-change choices are original
Simultaneous legs concentrate common USD exposure

hypothesis.behavior: A synchronized transition to at least five of six FX pairs agreeing on four-change USD direction may continue as a broad dollar impulse or fade over 30-60 minutes.
hypothesis.mechanism: Broad agreement can reflect common USD order flow rather than pair-specific noise; alternatively near-unanimity may mark short-horizon crowding or exhaustion.
works_when: Synchronized breadth isolates common USD flow
One response sign survives both holds and six-leg costs
fails_when: Agreement is mechanical common-factor exposure without predictability
falsifiable_predictions: Both hold cells for one response mode have positive basket net R under normal/doubled costs
The 60-minute center is positive in both UTC halves with at least four positive leg contributions per half
Both cells survive common five-date removal and meet event-count gates

definitions.name: usd_orientation
definitions.formula: q_s=-1 for EURUSD GBPUSD AUDUSD NZDUSD; q_s=+1 for USDCHF USDCAD

definitions.name: usd_score_current
definitions.timing: Four synchronized completed M15 changes; require finite nonzero prices

definitions.name: breadth_counts
definitions.formula: Bplus_j=count_s(u_{s,j}>0), Bminus_j=count_s(u_{s,j}<0); exact zeros count neither

definitions.name: usd_breadth_direction
definitions.formula: +1 iff Bplus_{t-1}<5 AND Bplus_t>=5; -1 iff Bminus_{t-1}<5 AND Bminus_t>=5; otherwise 0
definitions.timing: Known at synchronized t close; the two events are mutually exclusive

definitions.name: atr96_prior_by_symbol
definitions.formula: Wilder ATR(96) for each symbol through t-1
definitions.timing: Frozen before basket signal; every leg requires finite positive ATR

definitions.name: pair_trade_side
definitions.formula: FOLLOW_BREADTH: usd_breadth_direction*q_s; FADE_BREADTH: -usd_breadth_direction*q_s; +1 means long pair and -1 short pair
definitions.timing: Mechanical six-leg map at event close

entries.long_condition: for symbol s: eligible synchronized breadth transition AND pair_trade_side_s=+1 AND cell has no open basket
entries.short_condition: for symbol s: eligible synchronized breadth transition AND pair_trade_side_s=-1 AND cell has no open basket
entries.signal_time: Synchronized close of London M15 interval ending 09:00 through 13:45 on weekday when signal time plus holding_minutes<=15:00
entries.execution_details: Atomically enter all six legs at their final synchronized M1 chart/bid closes; V2 applies each leg's resolved/fallback spread, commission and slippage. No partial basket is permitted. Entry candles cannot trigger stops; management starts next M1.
entries.order_type: Six simultaneous supported signal-close market orders
restrictions: Cell must be flat across the entire basket
All six data streams, ATRs, costs and sizes must be valid and representable or the cell skips the whole basket event
Persistent same-side breadth >=5 cannot retrigger until it falls below five and later re-enters; a direct opposite-consensus transition qualifies under its Boolean
Out-of-window transitions are not traded but remain part of the rolling prior/current state

exits.stop_loss: Each leg uses one frozen symbol ATR: long bid-chart stop=signal_close_bid-ATR_s; short=signal_close_bid+ATR_s. Long triggers bid, short executable ask; adverse gaps fill at worse executable open with costs.
exits.time_exit: Exit every surviving leg at its synchronized M1 close ending exactly signal_time plus holding_minutes; any invalid required leg interval in (entry_time,due_exit_time] fails the entire affected cell; on a valid due bar each leg resolves STOP_LOSS before TIME_EXIT
exits.maximum_holding: At most 60 minutes and never after 15:00 Europe/London
exits.end_of_session: No basket matures after 15:00; any post-entry required-leg defect fails the affected cell rather than retaining a partial estimand

risk.position_sizing: Each cell owns one isolated basket portfolio. All six legs size from one common pre-entry equity snapshot at 0.08% chart-stop risk per leg before costs; no state crosses cells.
risk.maximum_risk_per_trade: 0.08% current equity per leg before costs
risk.gross_exposure_limit: Exactly six legs and at most 0.48% aggregate initial chart-stop risk per basket per cell
risk.leverage: Require every leg to satisfy V2 size/leverage limits; otherwise skip the entire cell event
risk.concurrent_positions: Within a cell either zero or one six-leg basket; four cells independently track equity, positions and failures

experiment.baseline: four-change five-of-six USD breadth rising transition/six one-ATR legs; FOLLOW_BREADTH; hold=60
robustness_tests: Report all four cells as event-level basket portfolios and retain full breadth ledger
Report basket events, all six leg contributions and UTC-midpoint halves; midpoint event belongs first half
Double spread, commission and slippage individually on every leg
For each mode center hold=60 remove five best normal-cost London basket dates from both hold cells; require both normal/doubled basket net R positive
For both cells use eligible synchronized London weekdays including zero-event days and 10000 circular five-date bootstrap resamples seed 2026019; center basket lower bound must exceed zero
Mode advances only if hold=60 center and hold=30 neighbor both pass
Require center at least 100 synchronized basket events, 600 entered legs, and at least four positive symbol contributions in each half
Report missing-symbol suppressions, unrepresentable atomic baskets, out-of-window transitions and event concentration
costs: Use resolved/fallback spread, commission and slippage at every leg fill
Double each component for all legs
benchmarks: Zero basket net R after all leg costs
Opposite response mode on identical breadth transitions
experiment.multiple_testing: Count all 336 selectable R007-R019 cells, two R008 diagnostics, the Menkhoff currency-momentum family, R005 pair/session diagnostics, and every named cross-symbol USD breadth or momentum trial. Cross-batch promotion uses full ledger; incomplete IDs prohibit confirmation; no best-cell/family/leg rescue.
rejection_criteria: Reject mode unless both holds have positive basket net R normal/doubled
Reject if center basket net R is non-positive in either UTC half or fewer than four symbols contribute positively in either half
Reject if center has fewer than 100 basket events or 600 legs
Reject if five-date removal makes either cell non-positive
Reject if center bootstrap lower bound is not above zero
Reject promotion on any required-cell or atomic-basket data failure
Never access holdout without explicit authorization for separately frozen version

pseudocode: Build synchronized valid London M15 bars for all six pairs.
Maintain per-symbol observed-sequence ATR96 through t-1.
For synchronized t-5..t compute prior/current four-change USD-oriented scores and breadth counts.
Trigger only a below-five to at-least-five transition in one USD direction.
For each flat cell map follow/fade to all six pair sides, validate every size/cost, then atomically enter all legs.
From next synchronized M1 process each leg stop before due exit; any required-leg defect fails the cell.
Publish four basket cells, leg contributions and full robustness/ledger rows.
required_libraries: existing V2 synchronized candle, timezone, cost, fill and R-accounting components
data_structures: Atomic six-leg basket state per cell
edge_cases: exact zero score counts neither sign
five and six agreeing pairs both qualify
prior equality five cannot trigger same side
direct transition from one consensus to the opposite can qualify
missing or misaligned symbol suppresses pre-entry event
any invalid size suppresses whole cell basket
each leg stop precedes due exit
adverse gaps use worse executable opens
post-entry defect in any required leg fails whole affected cell
implementation.computational_requirements: One synchronized causal pass over six symbols with four isolated atomic-basket portfolios.
known_backtester_gaps: Queue waits for V2 synchronized cross-symbol feature, atomic basket, per-leg cost/fill and event-level result compatibility confirmation
